If the same dependency is pinned in more than one place — several language implementations, a Dockerfile, a workflow — bring every pin to the same version. A repository that pins one library at four different versions has four different behaviours.

Run the full build, test and lint suite of every ecosystem after updating, and make CI green. Resolve every new deprecation warning the update introduces rather than leaving it for the next reader.

Check the security advisories for the tree as it stands afterwards (`npm audit`, `cargo audit`, `pip-audit`, `bundle audit`, `dotnet list package --vulnerable`, or the ecosystem equivalent) and make sure the update leaves none unresolved.

Report to each dependency’s upstream all general logic or duplicated code that belongs in that dependency, missing features, and bugs that lead to workarounds in this repository. Search existing upstream issues first, then create or update a report with a minimal reproducible example, affected versions, the local workaround, and a suggested fix in code or feature proposal; link every report from the pull request. Keep necessary workarounds in this repository so upstream fixes do not block the pull request.

issue.title: Update dependencies across all ten language implementations

repository.name: links-notation
repository.description: A way to describe data using references and links.

issue.body:
Fixes #405

Refresh dependencies, native locks and toolchain selections across all ten language implementations, benchmarks, examples, experiments and the archived templates requested by the issue. This includes or supersedes Dependabot PRs #361, #395, #396, #400, #401, #403 and #404, expands Dependabot manifest coverage, and prepares the normal 0.31.4 release trigger.

The API migrations replace the separate Java formatter launcher with native Spotless, replace removed artifact glob internals with supported glob APIs, and keep Kotlin's reporter working with Mocha 12. Obsolete dependency overrides are removed. Current formatter dependencies eliminate three Logback advisories; the coupled embedded compiler remains at its supported version after a reproducing incompatibility test. Release auditing now retries transient transport failures with a finite bound while retaining HTTP, metadata and exhausted-retry failures.

The [requirement ledger](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/dev/log/issues/405/pulls/406/PLAN.md), [analysis and migration review](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/dev/log/issues/405/pulls/406/analysis.md), [registry-backed dependency tables](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/dev/log/issues/405/pulls/406/research/dependency-tables.md) and [validation record](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/dev/log/issues/405/pulls/406/validation.md) contain the complete evidence. Native lock tables, 800 runtime selections, exact JVM graphs, retained-version reasons and compressed command logs are in the same folder.

Local validation covers all ten active language suites plus their build/lint checks, docs/benchmark checks, 25 focused regression tests, workflow/security checks and parity. Restored archived snapshots additionally pass 487 and 1,050 JS tests, 112 and 128 PHP tests, and 303 C# helper tests. Current minted executable/styles replace the obsolete Python wrapper; universal CI locks now install on both Python 3.11 and 3.15. JavaScript: 368 tests; Java: 226; C#: 363; PHP: 278; C++: 383. Python and Swift retain one existing skip each. Native npm, Yarn, Cargo, Python, Composer, NuGet and Go audits and the final exact Maven/Gradle OSV graph have zero reported advisories. All six hosted workflows passed on final head `006d2bc16e3553e2bfe8b7c3f1e14f039400debb`, including platform/matrix coverage: 87 successful CI jobs and four existing conditional publishing/release skips. The [exact-head CI run](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/43534054056) includes the new artifact regressions; links, dependency freshness, workflow/security lint, BOM checking and pages also passed. Skipped jobs are not registry delivery.

Reproduce the fixed failures with the saved before-fix regressions and final checks:

```sh
node --test experiments/issue-339/release-audit.test.mjs
node --test experiments/issue-405/artifact-files.test.mjs
node --test experiments/issue-405/mocha-reporter.test.mjs
python3 experiments/issue-348/test_dependabot_check.py
node scripts/ci/check-parity.mjs
```

Both artifact adapters preserve directory subtree exclusions, wildcard-directory descent, ordered reinclusion, comments and tilde expansion; four new regressions fail before the final correction and pass afterward. The artifact fixtures require installing both archived action packages; the Mocha fixture requires Kotlin's generated Node dependencies. CI performs those installations. No shared syntax/API contract changes or removed language features are intended. No registry publication of 0.31.4 is claimed.

New upstream reports/updates after searching existing issues: [Actions glob API](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/issues/2564#issuecomment-6865793053), [Kotlin Mocha reporter](https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlin-web-helpers/issues/19), [Scriv exact pins](https://github.com/nedbat/scriv/issues/208), [vcpkg benchmark port](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/55056), and [ktlint stable Logback graph](https://github.com/ktlint/ktlint/issues/3230#issuecomment-6867101340).

Existing upstream causes rechecked: [Dependabot Maven configuration](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/16797), [Yarn-only lock](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/16798), [KGP Gradle warning](https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/39685), [ktlint compiler compatibility](https://github.com/ktlint/ktlint/issues/3403), [ktlint Unsafe warning](https://github.com/JLLeitschuh/ktlint-gradle/issues/944), [download-artifact Buffer](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/issues/484), [deploy-pages punycode](https://github.com/actions/deploy-pages/issues/413), and [ESLint's fixed dependency graph](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/21463), and [VSTest's container artifacts directory](https://github.com/microsoft/vstest/issues/16652). The documented container base-directory configuration removes the new VSTest warning while preserving its security checks. The twelve previously reported template issues are linked individually in the [preserved report index](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-405-e18bfd98e937/dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/upstream/URLS.txt).

Unfinished criteria remain explicit: the KGP rootPackageJson input-tracking report is researched and drafted but unfiled because upstream requires an authenticated YouTrack account unavailable here; the local workaround remains. Exact archived application sources were restored temporarily from their recorded commits, and the updated integration/policy checks pass. Native resolution/audits also pass. These limits are detailed in the validation record. Keep this PR unmerged while the upstream-report criterion remains unresolved.

The implementation is ready for review. The working tree is clean, the latest main is included, all four issue/PR discussion/review endpoints were refreshed with no outstanding feedback, and the complete native diff plus paginated PR-files fallback was reviewed (GitHub rejects diffs over 300 files). R17 remains unfinished solely for the authenticated YouTrack submission above; this PR remains unmerged.

issue.body:
### Dependabot pull requests merged before this issue was created

These Dependabot pull requests could not be merged automatically and are still open:

- [#396](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/pull/396) chore(deps): Bump the actions-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 4 updates → `main` — not passing: [dependency freshness / latest-stable](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/actions/runs/43522079624/job/132218602878) (failure) — skipped: merge conflict with the base branch
- [#407](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/pull/407) chore(deps): Bump dotnet-sdk from 10.0.402 to 11.0.100 in /csharp → `main` — all 89 check(s) passing — merge failed: GraphQL: Repository rule violations found

Apply each of these updates in this issue’s pull request (Dependabot closes a pull request by itself once its update has landed), and fix the errors that made it unmergeable — a failing check, a conflict, or a repository setting such as a disabled auto-merge.

### Dependency ecosystems detected in this repository

Update **every** ecosystem below, in this order (most of the repository first). One pull request may cover them all, but each ecosystem must end up fully current — not partially.

1. **JavaScript / TypeScript**
   - Detected languages: JavaScript, TypeScript
   - Manifests: `benchmarks/js/package.json`, `benchmarks/tools/package.json`, `dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/templates/js/package.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/csharp/package.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/js/.github/actions/artifact-transport/package.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/js/package.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/python/.github/actions/artifact/package.json`, `docs/comparison/package.json`, `docs/website/package.json`, `js/package.json`
   - Lockfiles to regenerate and commit: `benchmarks/js/package-lock.json`, `benchmarks/tools/package-lock.json`, `dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/templates/js/package-lock.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/csharp/package-lock.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/js/.github/actions/artifact-transport/package-lock.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/js/package-lock.json`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/python/.github/actions/artifact/package-lock.json`, `docs/comparison/package-lock.json`, `docs/website/package-lock.json`, `js/bun.lock`, `js/package-lock.json`, `kotlin/kotlin-js-store/yarn.lock`
   - Update everything: `npx npm-check-updates -u && npm install`
   - `npm update` stays inside the existing semver ranges and never crosses a major; `npm-check-updates -u` rewrites package.json to the `latest` dist-tag.

2. **Rust**
   - Detected languages: Rust
   - Manifests: `dev/log/issues/330/pulls/331/templates/rust/Cargo.toml`, `dev/log/issues/377/pulls/378/templates/rust/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-209/lino-shapes/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-282/parity/rust/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-301/rust-probe/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-314/rust-differential/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-314/rust-probe/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-315/rust-probe/Cargo.toml`, `experiments/issue-316/rust-timing/Cargo.toml`, `rust/Cargo.toml`, `rust/links-notation-benchmark/Cargo.toml`, `rust/links-notation-macro/Cargo.toml`, `rust/links-notation/Cargo.toml`

   - Plain `cargo update` only moves Cargo.lock inside the requirements already in Cargo.toml. `cargo update --breaking` rewrites them but is nightly-only (`-Z unstable-options`), so `cargo upgrade --incompatible` from cargo-edit is the stable route. Revisit `edition` and `rust-version` too.

"All" is literal: development dependencies, transitive lockfile entries, build plugins, test runners, linters, base images, GitHub Actions, and the language/toolchain versions themselves.

For each ecosystem, produce a table of every dependency with the version pinned today and the version released today, resolved from the registry — not from memory. Anything left behind must have a written reason recorded (an upstream bug, a dropped platform, a paid tier), not silence.

Cross major versions deliberately. Read the changelog and the migration guide for every major bump, adapt the code to the new API, and remove the shims the old version needed. A constraint loosened or a test skipped to make a major "pass" is not an update.

Use the new features. Where a newer version replaces something this repository implements by hand, delete the hand-rolled copy and use the upstream feature, so there is less duplicated code and logic afterwards than before.

Make the constraints honest: raise floors that are years below what is actually installed, drop upper bounds that exclude the current release, and regenerate and commit every lockfile so a fresh install and CI resolve the same tree.

If the same dependency is pinned in more than one place — several language implementations, a Dockerfile, a workflow — bring every pin to the same version. A repository that pins one library at four different versions has four different behaviours.

Run the full build, test and lint suite of every ecosystem after updating, and make CI green. Resolve every new deprecation warning the update introduces rather than leaving it for the next reader.

Check the security advisories for the tree as it stands afterwards (`npm audit`, `cargo audit`, `pip-audit`, `bundle audit`, `dotnet list package --vulnerable`, or the ecosystem equivalent) and make sure the update leaves none unresolved.

Report to each dependency’s upstream all general logic or duplicated code that belongs in that dependency, missing features, and bugs that lead to workarounds in this repository. Search existing upstream issues first, then create or update a report with a minimal reproducible example, affected versions, the local workaround, and a suggested fix in code or feature proposal; link every report from the pull request. Keep necessary workarounds in this repository so upstream fixes do not block the pull request.

issue.title: chore(deps): refresh all ecosystems, preserve CI behavior and document upstream gaps

repository.name: links-notation
repository.description: A way to describe data using references and links.

issue.body:
Refresh every repository dependency graph against 2026-11-14 registry releases, including archived templates, experiments, hooks, composite actions and C++ dependencies omitted by the issue detector. This incorporates or supersedes Dependabot #396 and #407 while preserving branch rules and existing platform coverage.

- Update setup-java 6.3.0 and install-action 2.90.4 across all copies; preserve Java compiler annotations with the native `problem-matcher` input and a JS regression that failed before the migration.
- Align Python defaults at 3.15.2, advance the vcpkg baseline, refresh all native locks and track four previously missing locks. Prepare version 0.31.5 across all ten bindings and regenerate the deterministic benchmark report.
- Align archived cargo-audit inputs at 0.23.0, matching the native auditor; inventory all embedded Cargo tool selections, including installer defaults and test inputs.
- Preserve tested consumer floors and necessary upstream API constraints. The evidence contains 918 declarations, 2,250 lock entries, 800 runtime selections, 230 JVM graph edges and individual reasons for retained versions.
- Review 95 inline tools/images: migrate both npm helpers to 12.2.2 with upstream semver, lock current browser libraries, match Playwright images, pin current pip/Staticcheck/DocFX helpers and hash-lock Python publishing tools. Eight npm/installed-loader tests and a real preview-script smoke pass; the old CDN loader and its platform/network skips are removed.

Validation: JS 368 tests, Python 443 passed plus one existing platform skip, PHP 278 tests, Rust workspace/no-default/fmt/Clippy/benchmark checks, Java Maven install/tests, website build/lint, workflow linters, native lock refreshes, ten-language parity and release consistency passed locally. Native npm/Bun/Yarn, Cargo, Python, Composer, NuGet, JVM OSV and Go 1.27.4 audits found no advisories in the refreshed graphs. Full platform build/test/lint/security/docs checks run on this PR; skipped publishers are not delivery evidence.

[Analysis, requirement ledger, registry tables and preserved logs](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/tree/issue-408-891b7bc77ff4/dev/log/issues/408/pulls/409)

Archive verification limit: full tests/lint in the historical JS snapshots reproduce missing-file failures from the initial SHA; both changed preview contracts and all migration regressions pass. Detailed baseline/final logs are retained.

Upstream reports and remaining limitation: [report ledger](https://github.com/link-foundation/links-notation/blob/issue-408-891b7bc77ff4/dev/log/issues/408/pulls/409/upstream/README.md), including newly filed [composer/composer#13274](https://github.com/composer/composer/issues/13274). **R18 is unfinished for the Kotlin task-input report:** the bounded KGP 2.4.21 reproduction still fails, but the correct YouTrack project rejects submission with HTTP 403 and no authenticated account is available. The complete report, fresh reproduction and rejection evidence are committed. The local regeneration workaround remains; keep this PR unmerged while that reporting criterion is unresolved.

The initial CI failure was an existing registry/GitHub-release mismatch for Kotlin 0.31.4; the release audit remains strict. This PR verifies the distinct pending 0.31.5 version and does not create a release or claim registry delivery.

Fixes #408
